name: InitRingBuffer
evidence: stores its two arguments at +4 (the size, which ResetRingBuffer reads) and +0 (the buffer func_0013C9D0 writes at) and calls func_0013C9B0

name: ResetRingBuffer
evidence: zeroes the write position 0x08, read position 0x0C, filled count 0x14, counters 0x18 and 0x1C and sets the free count 0x10 to the size at +4

name: FillRingBuffer
evidence: reads up to n bytes (all free space when n <= 0) through a MemoryReader's read entry into buf + write position, wrapping the position modulo the size and moving the free count to the filled count

name: DrainRingBuffer
evidence: hands up to n filled bytes from the read position 0x0C to an object's virtual at +0x0C in wrapping chunks, adds each chunk to the free count and to one of two totals by the object's second virtual

name: FillRingBufferFromMemory
evidence: builds a MemoryReader over a block with the vtable D_00249D98 on its stack and passes it to FillRingBuffer

name: ConsumeSpan
evidence: adds n (or all that remains when n is 0) to the start at +0x10 and subtracts it from the remaining count at +0x18; nothing when none remains

name: ReadMemoryReader
evidence: slot 1 of the table D_00249D98: copies min(want, remain) bytes from base+pos to the destination and advances pos and shrinks remain

name: ReadNothing
evidence: the one virtual of the reader's base class (entry 1 of D_00249D80, where ReadMemoryReader is in the memory reader's table): returns 0, no bytes read
